requirements.value: Applicant must be currently active and in good standing, have practiced at least 3 of the 5 preceding years, hold a valid license in another state, have no pending disciplinary proceedings, and the other state's requirements must be equivalent to or higher than NC's. Application must be made within 6 months of the certificate from the other state's board.
requirements.quote: The applicant is currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing, and the applicant has practiced at least three out of the five years immediately preceding his or her application, and the applicant currently holds a valid license in another state, and no disciplinary proceeding or unresolved complaint is pending anywhere at the time a license is to be issued by this State, and the licensure requirements in the other state are equivalent to or higher than those required by this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent use of intoxicants, drugs, or narcotics impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of criminal provisions of the optometry article or plea of guilty/nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of provisions of the article or board rules, or aiding others in such violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to substance abuse or physical/mental illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety by reason of abuse of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of substance, or by reason of any physical or mental illness, abnormality, or other limiting condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of name, diploma, or license by another for illegal practice or fraudulent licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct that discredits the optometry profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the optometry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding unlicensed persons to perform acts that require a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act of service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article can lawfully be done or performed only by an optometrist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge, or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, in the practice of optometry, committed an act or acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an optometric assistant in his employ or under his supervision to do or perform any act or acts violative to this Article or of the rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of optometry

definition_quote.value: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or the employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or the prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa.
definition_quote.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified by the Board may prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry. Dispensing optometrists may dispense legend or prescription drugs (but not controlled substances) to their own patients after registering with the NC Board of Pharmacy.
drug_authority.quote: no optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents
